1. Start Walkthrough VM 2 and replicate the curl command we learned in this section in order to map and exploit the vulnerable APIs.

Next, perform a brute force attack to discover another API that has a same pattern as /users/v1.

Then, perform a query against the base path of the new API: what's the name of the item belonging to the admin user?

NOTE: A dirbuster wordlist should help on this task.
